metric.name: verified_project_milestones
metric.description: Strict all-or-nothing milestones. Only verified items count; partial work receives zero credit.

milestones.description: ROM size, cartridge type, bank count, and RAM configuration are validated from the header.
Physical bank 0 is mapped and byte-verified at CPU $0000-$3fff.
Physical bank 1 is mapped and byte-verified in a CPU $4000-$7fff overlay.
Physical bank 2 is mapped and byte-verified in a CPU $4000-$7fff overlay.
Physical bank 3 is mapped and byte-verified in a CPU $4000-$7fff overlay.
All four banks have reviewed code/data boundaries.
Reviewed ROM function entry points have stable banked symbols and a machine-readable inventory with explicit native-counterpart status.
Every menu item routes to the correct native mode.
All configurable settings persist and affect gameplay.
One-on-One has verified start, play, result dismissal/exit, overtime, and tournament-return flow.
One-on-One scoring, possession, clock, winners-outs, collision, steal, block, and rebound rules match the ROM.
Free Throw timing, attempts, scoring, results, and exit flow match the ROM.
Tournament winner propagation, rounds, bracket state, and championship flow match the ROM.
H-O-R-S-E called-shot, matching, letter, turn, and win rules match the ROM.
Accuracy Shootout targets, timing, scoring, and completion match the ROM.
The native port supports the selected two-player gameplay flow with two input streams.
Shot, rim, backboard, bounce, and rebound physics are verified against ROM traces.
CPU decisions and difficulty/player-rating effects are verified against ROM traces.
Player and ball animation-state selection is verified against the ROM.
ROM music/SFX commands, timing, and channel behavior are represented natively and verified.
Required tilemaps, portraits, logos, animations, roster records, and audio data are extracted from the user ROM.
Runtime presentation uses the generated asset pack rather than compiled derived-art arrays.
Emulator and native builds can run the same deterministic scripted inputs.
Automated checkpoints compare ROM WRAM state with native game state.
Automated frame comparisons cover representative states and complete mode flows.

history.note: Audited baseline: ROM identity plus physical banks 0 and 1 mapped.
MBC1 overlays added and byte-verified for physical banks 2 and 3.
Recovered and decompiled 83 reviewed bank-aware functions and added explicit C-counterpart status.
Verified five-mode routing and the ROM-backed One-on-One lifecycle, including overtime, result exit, and tournament winner return.
Verified session-persistent ROM settings, exact value cycles, and downstream gameplay consumption; added partial One-on-One possession and winners-outs rules.
Verified the seven-match tournament bracket, winner validation and propagation, round transitions, championship lock, and title return.

Completed the shared $702D player controller and full $7170 CPU synthetic-input controller, including mode dispatch, offense/defense routes, 8/4/1 hysteresis, contact response, loose-ball chase, and record-gated shooting, with native fixtures and Mesen traces.

Replaced the Free Throw gauge prototype with the traced $0C8E/$100F mode: exact 8.8 aim and launch, $1A31 rim/make sequence, $1C61 delayed net/score, 5/10/20 attempts, result/exit flow, and ROM-derived $08/$0A audio.
